en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street corner with a large three‑story commercial building labeled "BAZAR" on multiple facades. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the sidewalk in front of shop windows at ground level. Decorative text in German is printed above and below the photograph, including a greeting from Karlsbad and details about the bazaar's location on Kaiser Franz‑Josef‑Straße and its connection to the firm Bernard Sadler's widow.
